If you wanted to protect your privacy, you might have been told to do this.

Disable location services on your device. 

The problem is if you do this, you can't use map navigation and your location is still tracked by your phone and many apps on it. 

So today, I'll show you everything you need to do to protect your location from all threats. Properly and without any leaks. And you still get to use your maps completely privately. 

You don't need to disable location services in order for apps on your phone not having access to it. On modern Android, iOS and GrapheneOS, you should go to the location permission settings and revoke location access to apps that don't need it.
